verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents a Claude Code integration in which Claude Code triggers CodeRabbit reviews and fixes the resulting issues without manual intervention. The CLI/IDE docs claim seamless integration with AI coding agents, and pricing lists 'loops with coding agents' and agentic reviews in agent loops, so the core hand-off of findings to an agent is delivered. missing for 10: documented copyable per-finding fix prompts, explicit Codex and Cursor-agent integration details (the Cursor evidence covers only the IDE extension), independent or hands-on corroboration of the agent hand-off.
